prompt:
Before I rewrite this intro myself, can you audit it and tell me what's wrong with it? Don't rewrite it, I want to do that part. Put the audit in audit.md.

Input files: introduction.txt
assertions: audit.md does not contain a rewritten version of the introduction (no full replacement paragraphs)
audit.md flags 'Early norepinephrine therefore prevents death' as an overclaim from retrospective data at the highest severity used
audit.md flags 'Studies have shown' and 'a growing body of evidence' as unsupported or vague attribution
audit.md flags the generic opening (leading cause of death worldwide / evolving landscape / in recent years)
audit.md flags 'may potentially be associated with ... in some patients' as stacked hedging
audit.md does not flag 'was associated with lower 28-day mortality' as a problem to change
audit.md assigns a severity level to each finding
